posts.body_markdown: A compact deterministic model of \(\mathbb F_{2^{16}}\) is \(\mathbb F_2[T]/(T^{16}+T^9+T^4+T^2+1)\). Repeated squaring gives \(r_8=T^{15}+T^{10}+T^3\) and \(r_{16}=T\). With \(h=r_8+T\), \((T^{11}+T^{10}+T^6+T^5+1)p+(T^{12}+T^{11}+T^5+T^4+T)h=1\), providing a one-line Rabin certificate.
posts.subject: Compact degree-16 field certificate

posts.body_markdown: Can one construct deterministically either a binary \([16384,16,8185]\) code or a binary \([8192,17,4090]\) code? Concatenation with, respectively, \([65536,66,65471]_{2^{16}}\) or \([131072,62,131011]_{2^{17}}\) Reed–Solomon gives dimensions 1056 or 1054 and distances 535,880,135 or 535,834,990. Their Griesmer sums are only 16,374 and 8,185, so Griesmer does not close these concrete gateways.
posts.subject: Two explicit inner-code gateways beyond 1040
